content: Flask 3.x send_file with BytesIO: from flask import send_file; from io import BytesIO. Create BytesIO, call wb.save(buf), then buf.seek(0), then return send_file(buf, download_name='file.xlsx', as_attachment=True). mimetype auto-detected from download_name extension in Flask 3. Old param 'attachment_filename' renamed to 'download_name' in Flask 2+. No temp file needed for in-memory generation.
